info.name: Fileam Backend API (Updated)
info.description:
Fileam Backend API. Payment status: Cash -> PAID on create; Transfer/Card -> IN_PROGRESS on create, confirmed to PAID via PATCH .../payment-status; Invoice -> calculated from invoiceAmountPaid.total + invoiceDueDate (Pending|Partial|PAID|Overdue). CANCELLED remains manual. invoiceAmountPaid = { total, items:[{amount,paymentType:Cash|Transfer|Card}] } with total === sum(items). On PATCH update: Cash -> PAID; Card/Transfer -> IN_PROGRESS (payments reset unless invoiceAmountPaid sent); Invoice -> Pending when unpaid / calculated when invoiceAmountPaid sent. Bulk sales & bulk expenses: default Transfer, created PAID (Invoice rows stay calculated). VAT-inclusive: Base = Total / 1.075, VAT = Total - Base.

Tax filings (mobile): VAT/WHT monthly; PIT annual (GET/POST /mobile/filings/pit/calculation|submit, NRS Fourth Schedule, due 31 Mar); CIT annual NTA 2025 (GET/POST /mobile/filings/cit/calculation|submit, 0%/30% + 4% development levy on assessable profit, due 30 Jun, periodMonth=12); Beneficiaries outbound WHT ledger (7 routes under /mobile/beneficiaries). Filing list/detail returns computation snapshot for PIT/CIT; periodLabel is year-only for PIT/CIT.

Assets summary: totalAssetValue = currentAssets + netNonCurrentAssets; non-current includes purchaseCost, accumulatedDepreciation, netNonCurrentAssets.

Financial Position: GET /mobile/financial-position — category names match Asset/Liability modules (non-current assets: Vehicle, Computer & IT, Machinery, Furniture, Buildings, Software Licences, Land, Others; current liabilities: Accounts Payable, Tax Payable, Salaries Payable, Pension Payable, NHF Payable, Interest Payable, Short-term Loans; no PPE / Intangible Assets / Payroll Payable rollups). Liability reporting (6): GET /mobile/liability/summary|dashboard|current-liabilities|non-current-liabilities|accounts-payable|cash-flow-impact. Liability register: POST/GET /mobile/liabilities, GET /mobile/liabilities/{liabilityId}. Liability register: POST/GET /mobile/liabilities, GET /mobile/liabilities/{liabilityId}. Repayments: GET /mobile/liabilities/repayments (all), GET /mobile/liabilities/repayments/{repaymentId}, POST/GET /mobile/liabilities/{liabilityId}/repayments (per liability). AP = Invoice/Pay Later only (Salary excluded); tax outstanding after remittances; shared totals with financial-position.

Evidence Vault categories: Sales-Transactions | Purchase-Invoices | Expense-Transactions | Assets | Payroll | Tax-Filings | Bank-Statement-Analysis | Accounts-Receivable | Accounts-Payable | Inventory-Transactions | Ledger-Watch-Findings. List returns totalDocuments; POST /documents uses linkedRecord (e.g. sale-{uuid}); uploadedBy is a string (optional on create; defaults to business name; auto evidence uses business name). GET /records/{category} for linkable records.

Customer Directory: POST/PATCH/GET /mobile/customers, GET /mobile/customers/dashboard, POST .../documents. Supplier Directory: POST/PATCH/GET /mobile/suppliers, GET /mobile/suppliers/dashboard, POST .../documents. Payers (Customers & Payers PDF): POST/GET/PATCH /mobile/payers, transactions, receivables, invoice payments, documents — envelope { data }. Employers (PIT profile PDF): POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /mobile/employers, GET .../income-history (auto-generated from remuneration; no manual POST), documents — taxComputation with NRS bands (no CRA). Beneficiaries (outbound WHT PDF): POST/GET/PATCH /mobile/beneficiaries, transactions, remit, documents. Directory linking: POST /mobile/sales, /mobile/expenses, /mobile/inventory/sell accept customer:{id,name} / supplier:{id,name}. Prepayments: POST/GET/PATCH /mobile/prepayments, assign-consultant, evidence, cancel; GET /mobile/assets/current-assets includes prepayments section. Enterprise Asset Management: /api/v1/enterprise/clients/:clientId/assets (pending, approve/return/expense, register, depreciation-schedule, history, reports, downloads).

App version (no auth): GET /mobile/app/version?platform=ios|android&version=x.y.z — forceUpdate when client is below MOBILE_*_MIN_VERSION; updateAvailable when below MOBILE_*_LATEST_VERSION. Configure via MOBILE_IOS_* / MOBILE_ANDROID_* / MOBILE_FORCE_UPDATE_MESSAGE env vars.

Employees tax relief: annualHouseRent (actual rent; PAYE relief = MIN(20%, ₦500k)), nhf (boolean), nhisHealthInsurance, lifeAssurancePremium, mortgageInterest, qualifyingMedicalExpenses.

Payroll, Assets, Liability, Financial Position and AI evidence-vault live under Mobile / AI Service.

item.name: Assets **
item.description: Fixed assets. Summary: totalAssetValue = currentAssets + netNonCurrentAssets (+ pendingCustomerReviews). Non-current: purchaseCost, accumulatedDepreciation, netNonCurrentAssets (total = NBV). Create requires depreciationMethod: STRAIGHT_LINE | REDUCING_BALANCE | UNIT_OF_PRODUCTION (legacy DECLINING_BALANCE / UNITS_OF_PRODUCTION accepted). STRAIGHT_LINE: usefulLife + residualValue. REDUCING_BALANCE: usefulLife + depreciationRate + residualValue. UNIT_OF_PRODUCTION: totalEstimatedUnit + unitProduced + residualValue. Book value never falls below residual.

request.description: totalAssetValue (= currentAssets + netNonCurrentAssets), currentAssets, netNonCurrentAssets (NBV after depreciation), pendingCustomerReviews (assets awaiting consultant review).

summary.pendingReviews; summary.currentAssets = cash+bank+inventory+AR; also summary.cash, bankBalances, inventory, accountsReceivable totals; summary.nonCurrentAssets = NBV of ACTIVE fixed assets; annualDepreciation; nonCurrentAssetCategories[]; plImpact.
cash, bankBalances (systemDerived + userAdded + items with source: system|user), inventory, accountsReceivable, prepayments. POST /assets/cash and /assets/bank-accounts appear under userAdded.
Assets with depreciationMethod UNIT_OF_PRODUCTION, not SOLD/DISPOSED.

purchaseCost, accumulatedDepreciation, netNonCurrentAssets (= purchaseCost − accumulatedDepreciation). total = netNonCurrentAssets. All 8 assetTypes always returned (even total 0); nested assets use NBV.
Per-asset straight-line depreciation schedule (book value, remaining life, annual charge).
POST /mobile/assets. depreciationMethod required. residualValue required and must be < purchaseCost. Example body is REDUCING_BALANCE; see sibling requests for other methods.

item.name: Liability **
item.description:
Liability reporting over existing books (do not duplicate data).

Six routes (spelling: liability):
1. GET /mobile/liability/summary
2. GET /mobile/liability/dashboard
3. GET /mobile/liability/current-liabilities
4. GET /mobile/liability/non-current-liabilities
5. GET /mobile/liability/accounts-payable
6. GET /mobile/liability/cash-flow-impact

Sources: AP ← Invoice/Pay Later (Salary excluded); Tax ← payables less remittances; Salaries ← unpaid Salary expenses; Pension/NHF ← pending payroll_obligations. Non-current loan balances ← Liability Register (/mobile/liabilities). Interest Payable / Short-Term Loan still stubbed at 0.

Statuses: OUTSTANDING | OVERDUE | ACTIVE | PARTIALLY_PAID | PAID. Percentages use class totals; divide-by-zero → 0.

request.description: totalLiability, currentLiability, nonCurrentLiability. Formula: total = current + non-current.
Overview: summary (incl. overduePayable) + lightweight current/non-current category lists (name, amount, percentage) + cashFlowImpact. Full trees → current-liabilities / accounts-payable.

Full current liability trees: Accounts Payable (with payables nested), Tax Payable (PAYE/VAT/WHT/CIT/PIT), Salaries, Pension, NHF, Interest Payable, Short-Term Loan. Returns { total, overduePayable, items[] }. Payable amount is included on payables.items[], upcomingPayables[], and suppliers[].payables[].

Non-current categories from Liability Register outstanding principal: Bank Loan, Director Loan, Shareholder Loan, Mortgage, Equipment Financing, Lease Liability, Convertible Loan, Other Long-term Borrowings. Returns { total, items[] }.

AP detail only: name, amount, percentage, payables { summary, items, upcomingPayables, ageingAnalysis, suppliers, reports }. Each payable item includes amount (outstanding) in items[], upcomingPayables[], and suppliers[].payables[] — same amount wherever the payable appears.

Liability settlement cash impact for current calendar month: netCashOutflow (incl. debt principal+interest repayments), overdueSettlement, scheduledDebtRepayment, interestExpense, interestDue (open accrued on register).

item.name: Financial Position **
item.description: GET /mobile/financial-position — complete financial position for the mobile Financial Position screen. Backend owns all totals, percentages, and health metrics. Category names match Asset/Liability modules (no PPE/Intangible/Payroll Payable rollups). Non-current assets: Vehicle, Computer & IT, Machinery, Furniture, Buildings, Software Licences, Land, Others. Current liabilities: Accounts Payable, Tax Payable, Salaries Payable, Pension Payable, NHF Payable, Interest Payable, Short-term Loans.

request.description:
Response data:
• summary: asset|liability|equity { amount, percentage }, total (= total assets)
• assets.currentAssets.items: Cash, Bank Balance, Inventory, Accounts Receivable
• assets.nonCurrentAssets.items: Vehicle, Computer & IT, Machinery, Furniture, Buildings, Software Licences, Land, Others (amounts from asset type NBV; zeros included)
• liabilities.currentLiabilities.items: Accounts Payable, Tax Payable, Salaries Payable, Pension Payable, NHF Payable, Interest Payable, Short-term Loans
• liabilities.nonCurrentLiabilities.items: Bank Loan, Director Loan, Shareholder Loan, Mortgage, Equipment Financing, Lease Liability, Convertible Loan, Other Long-term Borrowings
• equity.total = Assets − Liabilities
• financialHealth: currentRatio, debtToAssetRatio %, equityRatio %, workingCapital
